datasheet_identity.title: MM1W3V3 THRU MM1W330 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The MM1W30 row on p.2 specifies VZ minimum 28.2 V, nominal 30 V, and maximum 32.0 V at IZT = 8.5 mA; the nominal value is used for the breakdown-voltage field and the min/max spread is preserved here.
IZT is the published zener test current paired with VZ, not a separately labelled minimum, typical, or maximum limit; source_kind typical is used because the schema has no test-condition category.
The p.1 forward-voltage entry is in Maximum Ratings and specifies VF = 1.2 V at IF = 200 mA; it is retained as a maximum, not as a typical forward-voltage value.
The p.2 leakage-current entry specifies IR = 5 microA at VR = 23 V; it is treated as a maximum leakage-current limit because no typical leakage column is provided.
The datasheet does not publish capacitance, reverse-recovery time, ZZK/IZK, or a target-specific zener regulation curve; those fields are omitted or null.
Reverse-bias and breakdown values use the datasheet zener polarity: cathode positive relative to anode.
omission_reason: No usable target-specific electrical curve is present. The datasheet includes only generic family rating/thermal plots and no MM1W30-specific I-V, capacitance, or zener-regulation plot.

breakdown_current.conditions: Paired with nominal VZ = 30 V; reverse zener test current IZT = 8.5 mA, TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted; cathode positive relative to anode
